description: mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): the bridge (the session's live stream and its control from another terminal on the machine and from the desk — sminos watch, steer, interrupt, model, compact, decide, answer — through a child, sminos bridge, serving its endpoint; its <message> marks and async asks reach the project's log as they are written), mcp__sminos__AskUserQuestion (the built-in's input plus async, which withdraws the built-in), the session's sminos address (a Sminos-Session line, which sminos who reads back) at the end of every commit message and PR body it writes, and its name: a name sminos derive proposed after what the session is in charge of, applied at its next prompt as the engine's own rename when sminos name-due finds it still due. smns-record.sh (SessionStart, Stop): a session in a project joins its sminos log at its start, and its <message> marks and async asks reach the log as messages to the host (the bridge's export, where it runs, has put them there already). smns-guide.sh (SessionStart, every source): on a machine enrolled at a desk hub, the session reads who it is in the org (alias, project and why, machine) and the sminos verbs that find and reach the org's other sessions, and after a compaction or a resume the members it exchanged sminos messages with, as the logs hold them now
